validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real and singular - this is a specific, named trunk gas pipeline (920 km, DN1400/1420mm, ~37 bcm/y design capacity) proposed to run Ukhta (Komi Republic) -> Kirov Oblast -> Mari El -> Cheboksary (Chuvash Republic), first formally listed as position 11 of Appendix 4 to RF Government Order No. 816-r (13.05.2015, itself amending the territorial planning scheme established by Order No. 1416-r of 13.08.2013) and carried forward through Order No. 2915-r (22.12.2018). CLASSIFICATION: correctly PipelineType=transmission/trunk ('магистральный газопровод') per its listing among the Unified Gas Supply System's trunk-line appendix, not a distribution/отвод line - Interfax explicitly frames it as an inter-corridor interconnector meant to move Yamal-sourced gas between the 'Северный' and 'Центральный' transport corridors. DUPLICATE CHECK: no other GEM row or independent source describes a second, distinct 'Ukhta-Cheboksary' project or an alternate name for this same corridor - not a duplicate of any Ukhta-Torzhok line (those are separate, already-operating parallel strings on a different corridor). status_reviews.researcher_notes: TASK: resolve the tension flagged in the batch brief - GEM's prior researcher had suggested moving Status from 'shelved' (ShelvedYear 2024) to 'cancelled'. FINDING: no formal cancellation act exists. What exists is Order No. 406-r (28.02.2024), which REMOVES the pipeline from the RF territorial planning scheme's list of planned trunk gas pipelines (Appendix 4 to Order 816-r, position 11) - this is an act of exclusion from a forward-looking plan, not a decree that names and cancels a specific pipeline project. Re-checked the CURRENT (17.12.2025) edition of that same appendix directly (not relying on a cached/older copy) and confirmed the pipeline remains absent, with no reinstatement and no separate cancellation instrument found anywhere (checked consultant.ru, rulaws.ru, sudact.ru, garant.ru for any later act naming this project). Applying the batch's own dormancy rule (shelved -> cancelled requires >=4 years with no progress): the exclusion is from Feb 2024, so as of this Dec-2025 evidence date only ~1.8-2 years have elapsed - well short of the 4-year threshold. VERDICT: 'confirm' the current status ('shelved', ShelvedYear 2024) rather than 'change' to cancelled. This is a 'stale evidence, same conclusion' review, not a no-op: the evidence base is refreshed to a Dec-2025 primary-source check (vs GEM's Aug-2025 last-check), and a corrected account of what Order 406-r actually says is now on record (correcting a WebSearch-tool hallucination encountered mid-research, which had wrongly synthesized an active 2025-2027 construction schedule for this pipeline from unrelated decree content - verified false by reading Order 406-r's raw text directly). If a future check finds no reinstatement by roughly Feb 2028 (4 years post-exclusion), 'cancelled' with ShelvedCancelledType=inferred would become the correct call at that time.
